text:
zoe (ae): Heads up — GreenFold legal is blocking POC kickoff until the MSA is notarized and they want the PO on file. Can we avoid delaying next-week sandbox?
matt (sales-eng): POC pricing approved in SF. Two asks: notarization + HSM attestation. We can give an attestation letter for POC.
toni (legal): We should not set a broad precedent for notarization. Offer two execution paths: (1) e-notary (DocuSign/eID) which we accept; (2) physical notarization but allow scanned notarization certificate as interim evidence with originals mailed within 30 days. Limit notary to customer exec.
toni (legal): Also saw their indemnity redline — they expand vendor indemnity beyond acceptable scope. Counter with our standard 4.1: mutual indemnity for gross negligence/willful misconduct and an LCap equal to greater of $1M or prior 12 months' fees.
ella (finance): Default billing is net30. If GreenFold insists on net45 for POC we need PO + AR approval before provisioning. If PO uses net30 referenced to orderform we can provision once MSA signed.
zoe (ae): Can legal draft a 1-par addendum that states POC scope, sandbox-only data, pricing, and provisioning triggers (signed MSA + PO or e-notary)?
matt (sales-eng): I'm going to propose the two notarization options and include the HSM attestation outline (not full attestation docs) — that usually satisfies procurement for a sandbox.
toni (legal): Draft clause suggestion:
```
Execution and Notarization: This Agreement may be executed by (a) an electronically notarized signature using an industry-standard e-notary service, or (b) a physically notarized signature of Customer's authorized executive. If (b) is used, Customer shall provide a scanned copy of the notarization certificate at execution and deliver the original certificate to Vendor within thirty (30) days. The notarization requirement applies only to Customer's executive signature and does not modify acceptance of electronic signatures for any other party.
```
zoe (ae): GreenFold procurement reply: "physical notary preferred; we'll try to provide scanned certificate and PO this week."
matt (sales-eng): I'll DM procurement to confirm signer name and billing address for PO so finance can pre-approve.
ella (finance): If PO arrives with net30 referenced to the Order Form we'll expedite. If net45, we'll need AR approval and will hold provisioning until sign-off.
toni (legal): Also counter their subprocessor clause: change prior consent to notice + 30-day objection and add an escalation path. Proposed text:
```
Subprocessors: Vendor may engage subprocessors. Vendor will provide notice of new subprocessors and Customer will have thirty (30) days to object on legitimate data-protection grounds. If unresolved, parties will engage in good-faith discussions; Customer may temporarily suspend transfers pending resolution.
```
esign-bot: :page_facing_up: Envelope c9d3 created for GreenFold (MSA_GF_v4_redline.pdf, OrderForm_POC_GF.pdf). Status: awaiting customer signature.
zoe (ae): Thanks — I'll send the tracked changes + the one-paragraph POC addendum and request the PO.
matt (sales-eng): Counsel asked whether scanned notary + apostille is ok — I said yes pending legal clause.
toni (legal): OK to accept scanned copy with original mailed later; will include language about originals within 30 days and limit to exec only.
ella (finance): Acknowledged; watching for PO. If PO references orderform and uses net30 we can greenlight provisioning once MSA executed.
zoe (ae): Closing thread for now — will update when envelope is signed or PO received. :thumbsup:
